=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `lexer.instream.tell() - 1` points at the last character of the digit token, so the adjacency check reads that digit instead of the following redirect operator.
  WHY: For `git push origin 2>/dev/null`, the guard treats `2` as a push refspec and checks branch `2` instead of the current branch; the two new regression tests cannot pass with this off-by-one.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:268 (on disk) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `str.isdigit()` returns true for Unicode digit characters such as superscript `²`, which Bash does not interpret as file descriptors.
  WHY: `git push origin ²>/dev/null` can cause the guard to drop the `²` refspec and check the current branch instead of branch `²`.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:998-1004 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `test_template_copies_are_identical` unconditionally asserts byte-for-byte equality while the root and template guards diverge.
  WHY: CI reports four failures, including the parity assertion and three redirect tests against the stale root guard.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: The PR description states "The consumer merge guard template distinguishes a numeric file-descriptor prefix (`2>/dev/null`) from a separated or quoted numeric push refspec (`2 > /dev/null`), checking the branch actually pushed in either case." and the changelog entry makes the same claim. Expected change site: `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` `_shell_segments_with_operators` — the root copy must receive the same redirect handling as the template. Evidence of absence: The root guard at `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:262-270` is the original simple loop with no `redirect_target`, no digit-dropping, no `previous_token_end` tracking. All three LAST RUN DIFF test cases that exercise the redirect behavior (`test_numeric_push_refspec_before_redirect_is_not_lost`, `test_fd_redirect_checks_current_push_branch`, `test_quoted_numeric_refspec_before_redirect_is_preserved`) run against the guard loaded by `_load_guard()` at test time — which resolves to the root copy when it exists. CI confirms 3 of the 4 `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` failures come from these tests exercising the stale root guard. The fourth failure comes from the unconditional parity assertion at line 1000. SEVERITY: BLOCKER ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
